info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Underwritings-v5-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the underwriting details of mortgage loans, enabling users to retrieve comprehensive information related to loan applications. With this operation, financial institutions and underwriters can effectively assess risk and make informed lending decisions. Typical consumers include loan officers and risk analysts who require insights into the underwriting status of various mortgage applications. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline the underwriting process and enhance their decision-making capabilities.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed underwriting information for loans, including status, eligibility, and any required documentation. It provides critical insights for processors and underwriters to manage loan applications effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the underwriting details of loans. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify the loan information required for the underwriting process.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the underwriting details.
